name: Hadan'ya
source:
Main character looses his memory and gets hospitalized after an accident. Because of his memory problems he becomes a suspect. At this time appears a person who claims to know the protagonist well and who blames him guilty. Protagonist under pressure agrees to undertake a job to make couples break up for money. What awaits him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在事故后失去记忆并住进医院。由于记忆问题，他反而成了嫌疑人。此时，一名自称十分了解主人公的人出现，指责他犯有罪行。在巨大压力下，主人公同意接下一份工作：收取报酬，设法拆散情侣。等待他的将是什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
